name: Promo code
summary: Enter a discount code. After applying, the code shows as a Tag you can remove.
avoid: At the top of the checkout: it distracts and makes people go looking for codes.
reactProps: Return an error message, or nothing when it works.
behaviour: Empty field: the message "Enter a discount code."
While checking, the button shows it is loading.
a11y: The error is linked to the field. An applied code is announced as a status.
content: Error message with a solution: "We do not know this code. Check the spelling."
